research_evaluations.split_description: 160 synthetic learners × 6 observations; 96 train / 32 validation / 32 test learners; zero learner overlap

components.objective: Preserve first attempts separately from eventual completion
components.evidence_type: Synthetic event contract check, not predictive validation
components.input_summary: 18 canonical-schema synthetic sessions across six skills
components.claim: C1 can preserve failed first attempts even when later completion succeeds on correctly instrumented input.
components.limitation: Tests the event contract; it does not repair inconsistent Flutter attempt hooks or validate fatigue.

components.objective: Measure acoustic onset timing with known stimulus timing
components.input_summary: 40 generated tones with known leading silence; first20 baseline fit, final20 comparison
components.claim: Onset extraction is compared against known timings on controlled waveforms.
components.limitation: Harmonic tones are not Sinhala child speech. STT, pauses, jitter and shimmer still need labelled speech evaluation.

components.objective: Compare multimodal pattern classification with simpler baselines
components.input_summary: 13 correlated features; overlapping latent traits; independent device/task noise
components.claim: Scores report performance on this declared synthetic generator; any advantage or regression is shown without selecting only favorable metrics.
components.limitation: Labels and feature relationships are assumed. Frozen model used a different generator; candidate is not deployed. No Sri Lankan child validation.

components.input_summary: 80 learners × 20 responses per simulator; predict before update
components.claim: Prediction error is measured before each response updates the state.
components.limitation: Simulator is related to model assumptions. Does not establish better learning, calibrated item difficulty, or applied Flutter adaptation.
